notes: v536 — ⚖ “Does the grading work?”, a new report in Instant Reports. It asks the hardest question you can ask this app: if a signal line had earned a badge in an EARLIER year, did it go on to work in the year that FOLLOWED — or was the badge always arriving too late to be useful? The test uses the two older stored years, always measuring the window AFTER the verdict, never the one the verdict was based on, and compares badged lines against unbadged ones. It reports the answer whichever way it falls — including “you were right to worry”, in which case it says to lean on the 🌱 nursery and the trajectory instead of the badge. It also states plainly what it cannot tell you: the lines overlap, it is one market, and the thresholds being tested were chosen by us rather than discovered. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
